saw_lines: Nobody plans a cold drink at the till. They grab a familiar can on impulse, and the fridge decides it.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before the buyer scrolls past.
Your 30 ads carry no proof number. Collect one real figure, such as your review count, and lead three new ads with it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to weigh before tapping. Collect one real figure, such as your review count, and lead three new ads with it on the creative.

4 of your 16 copy ads open on “goditi la serata senza pensieri”, so most buyers see one angle only. Test two fresh openers against it, one on price and one on taste, and keep the one that runs longest.
0 of 16 copy ads mention any offer or discount, so a buyer who is not sure yet has no reason to act today. Open three new ads with a first order offer or a bundle on the creative.
22 ads have run 60 days or more, so you have proven winners. None of the 8 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build three ads as variations of the oldest winner, changing only the price line.

ads_1: Cold drink moments with a first order offer, tested against the evening opener
